info.author: xcode
info.comment: Flat vector empty-state illustration: no eaten entries. A white clipboard with a navy clip, completely blank page, and a small gray fork-and-knife crossed as a simple geometric mark in the corner. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, white, light gray #E6EBF2. No text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, generous negative space, crisp edges.
